images.chapterTitle: Chapter उन्नीस — कृष्ण द्वारा मुञ्जारण्य में महाग्नि से रक्षा
images.prompt: Krishna calms the forest fire in Munjavaranya, protecting its inhabitants with divine intervention.
images.caption: श्री कृष्ण शरणम् मम - As Krishna calms the forest fire in Munjavaranya, He reminds us of His divine protection and care for all living beings. May we seek refuge in His eternal love and mercy.

images.chapterTitle: Chapter उन्नीस — कृष्ण द्वारा मुञ्जारण्य में महाग्नि से रक्षा
images.prompt: Narada arrives at Munjavaranya, witnessing Krishna's miraculous rescue and praising his divine powers.
images.caption: दिव्य शक्ति (Divya Shakti) - Witnessing Krishna's miraculous rescue at Munjavaranya, we're reminded of His omnipotent power. May this divine intervention inspire our devotion and faith. Reflect on the Lord's protection in your life today.

images.chapterTitle: Chapter उन्नीस — कृष्ण द्वारा मुञ्जारण्य में महाग्नि से रक्षा
images.prompt: Krishna, surrounded by relieved inhabitants, smiles benevolently after saving Munjavaranya from the massive fire.
images.caption: अग्निं शांतय तदा कृष्णः, As Krishna calms the raging fire, we're reminded of His omnipresent care. May this scene inspire us to reflect on His divine protection in our lives.
